run.controller_input_semantics: x_plant_sensorized - x_ref; state order [p, v, pitch_error, pitch_rate]

nominal_model.scope: dynamic nominal solver and feedforward only; K4 unchanged

reference_lifecycle.completion_semantics: T_v is S-curve completion; T_full is the first feasible nominal horizon; existing FF fade starts at T_full
reference_lifecycle.preload: none; e_p and p_ref are not changed
reference_lifecycle.lean_completion: solver-constrained zero-lean/zero-rate endpoint at first feasible T_full; never the next command time

horizon_search.threshold_basis: V1 engineering threshold, not a theoretical feasibility theorem

reference_lifecycle.feedforward_exit_input: last solved nominal interval input; no cruise nominal solve

FF_FB_cancellation.definition: 1 - mean(abs(u_total)) / mean(abs(u_ff_used) + abs(u_fb)); larger means more opposing cancellation

launch_diagnostics.angle_convention: pitch error relative to nominal theta_eq; absolute-pitch zero crossing is recorded separately

configuration.completion_semantics: T_v is S-curve completion; T_full is the first feasible nominal horizon; existing FF fade starts at T_full
configuration.preload: none; e_p and p_ref are not changed
configuration.lean_completion: solver-constrained zero-lean/zero-rate endpoint at first feasible T_full; never the next command time

horizon_search.threshold_basis: V1 engineering threshold, not a theoretical feasibility theorem

configuration.feedforward_exit_input: last solved nominal interval input; no cruise nominal solve

transition_events.u_ff_terminal_convention: last solved interval (left-limit); no cruise input solve

pitch_filter_experiment.acceleration_source: previous control-time odometry velocity difference, first-order low-pass; no a_ref
pitch_filter_experiment.compensation_frame: world -Y longitudinal acceleration, rotated to chassis with gyro-predicted pitch

feedback.selection: retained K_old after new-A/B revalidation and limited Q/R challenge

baseline_manifest.scope_note: Stage 3A simulation limits only; not final physical-robot hardware limits

dynamic_nominal_horizon.threshold_basis: V1 engineering threshold, not a theoretical feasibility theorem

baseline_runtime.feedforward_actuator_contribution: lambda_ff * u_ff_lifecycle; feedback and lean reference unchanged
baseline_runtime.unsupported_mid_maneuver_retarget: nonzero-acceleration/nonzero-lean starts are not supported by the frozen shaper/zero-boundary solver; never reset them silently; fixed benchmark does not exercise this
